scenario.description: A chief risk officer must approve a borrower's request to substitute collateral on an existing securities-backed facility and finalize the replacement asset, collateral value, notice period, and release controls, with input from collateral risk, legal, and client coverage.

shared_context.S1: The bank has an active $10,000,000 securities-backed facility for Northstar Holdings.
shared_context.S2: Northstar has asked to replace its current collateral with a different security before the next interest payment date.
shared_context.S3: The current collateral is held under the bank's existing custody arrangement and the facility is performing as agreed.
shared_context.S4: Nadia makes the binding decision. Under the bank's normal pre-decision routine, collateral risk, legal, and client coverage each report any relevant file findings before the decision is recorded.

PF1.text: Elias's collateral stress test completed this morning shows that the proposed replacement must have a market value of exactly $14,000,000 at approval because its applicable haircut is 28%; he has not yet uploaded the test to the credit file.

PF2.text: Maya found this week that Northstar's executed pledge agreement requires two business days' notice before releasing existing collateral and requires a tri-party control agreement to be signed before the replacement is released; she has not yet added those clauses to the transaction checklist.

PF3.text: Jon confirmed with Northstar's treasury team this morning that the only replacement they can deliver at the required value is $14,000,000 of two-year U.S. Treasury notes; the client cannot deliver the equity basket described in the request, and Jon's confirmation remains in his coverage notes.

acceptance_conditions: The collateral substitution must be approved.
The replacement collateral must be two-year U.S. Treasury notes.
The replacement collateral market value must be exactly $14,000,000.
The existing collateral must not be released until a tri-party control agreement is signed.
At least two business days' notice must be provided before release.
The settlement must include a control-agreement commitment and a release-notice commitment.

content_checks.C2: ('two-year' in decisions['replacement_asset'] and 'Treasury notes' in decisions['replacement_asset']) or ('Two-year' in decisions['replacement_asset'] and 'Treasury notes' in decisions['replacement_asset'])
content_checks.C6: any('tri-party control agreement' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('two business days' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The performing facility and request do not establish a collateral amount, while PF1 changes replacement_market_value_usd from an unspecified or generic amount to exactly 14000000 and supplies the risk basis that must be cited.

The shared custody arrangement does not specify release protections, while PF2 changes release_only_after_control_agreement to true, notice_days_before_release to exactly 2, and adds both required legal-control commitments.
Without PF3, the requested substitute has no confirmed deliverable asset, so approval is not executable; PF3 changes replacement_asset to two-year U.S. Treasury notes and makes approval feasible.
